question.instructions: Decide whether to fight. Live monsters have category Monster and no Dead in their name.

criteria.fight: A live monster is on screen, or a compass monster is within 500 units with a bearing between -60 and 60 degrees.
criteria.clear: No live monster is on screen, and no compass monster is within 500 units ahead.

question.instructions: The way straight ahead is blocked: the middle rangefinder readings are small, or memory shows almost no distance moved while recent actions tried to move forward.
HEALTH is below 40 and a Medikit or Stimpack appears in the compass.
Aim at the nearest live monster, then fire. TURN_LEFT moves on-screen objects right; TURN_RIGHT moves them left.

criteria.ATTACK: The nearest live on-screen monster has x between -0.1 and 0.1.
criteria.TURN_LEFT: The target is left of center (x below -0.1), or it is off screen with a positive compass bearing.
criteria.TURN_RIGHT: The target is right of center (x above 0.1), or it is off screen with a negative compass bearing.

question.instructions: The way ahead is blocked. Get moving again, using the rangefinder to find open space.

criteria.MOVE_FORWARD+USE: A door or switch is directly ahead and has not just been used.
criteria.TURN_LEFT: The left rangefinder readings are larger than the right ones.
criteria.TURN_RIGHT: The right rangefinder readings are larger than the left ones.
criteria.MOVE_BACKWARD: All readings are small, so back away first.

question.instructions: Walk to the nearest Medikit or Stimpack in the compass.

criteria.MOVE_FORWARD: Its bearing is between -10 and 10 degrees.

question.instructions: Explore new parts of the map. Prefer open space, unvisited cells, items, and doors.

criteria.MOVE_FORWARD: The middle rangefinder readings are large and this cell has few visits.
criteria.MOVE_FORWARD+TURN_LEFT: There is more open space to the left, or an item has a positive bearing.
criteria.MOVE_FORWARD+TURN_RIGHT: There is more open space to the right, or an item has a negative bearing.
criteria.MOVE_FORWARD+USE: A door or switch is directly ahead.
